create_minimax_tool_parser: create a MinimaxToolParser instance to parse tool calls from Minimax model output using a tokenizer
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from Minimax model output by parsing JSON objects wrapped in <tool_calls> tags
preprocess_model_output: preprocess model output by removing tool calls embedded inside thinking tags
extract_tool_calls_streaming: extract tool calls incrementally during streaming by tracking state across text deltas
handle_tool_args_streaming: handle streaming of tool arguments by emitting delta messages with intermediate diffs
